module_title: CKA Week 7 - Troubleshooting (30% of the exam)
title: CKA Week 7 Challenge - Fix the Broken Cluster (14 Scenarios)
description: Fourteen deliberately broken workloads in one cluster. Follow the troubleshooting order - get, describe, events, logs, then config - and fix each one; most checks verify live traffic, not just object state.
scenario: It is Wednesday of Week 7: 15 broken scenarios, 8 minutes each. Everything in ns broken is broken ON PURPOSE: wrong images, crashing commands, impossible resources, silent Services, blocked policies, 404 ingresses. Diagnose, fix, verify.
symptoms: ipull cannot pull, crashy cannot run, huge cannot schedule, zero-dep runs nothing
two Services silently misrouted: wrong targetPort, wrong selector
an ingress answers 404, a NetworkPolicy blocks a working Service, a PVC never binds
mission: Get every broken object healthy again and prove each fix with live behavior, then write your root-cause notes to /root/diagnosis.md.

hints.title: The order
hints.content: get -> describe -> events -> logs -> config, from the node down. kubectl describe pod X shows the event that names the root cause for 10 of these 14 tasks.

hints.title: Immutable fields
hints.content: Pod resources/env and Job templates are immutable: export with -o yaml, edit, kubectl replace --force. Deployments can be patched in place.

hints.title: Silent Services
hints.content: A Service with NO endpoints = selector matches nothing. Endpoints but refused connection = wrong targetPort. Task 5 and 6 are exactly this pair.

hints.title: Traffic checks
hints.content: Tasks 5, 6, 11, 12 and 13 verify live behavior (wget/curl). If the object looks right but traffic fails, re-read the week 5 notes on endpoints and policies.

acceptance_criteria.description: ipull: wrong image fixed to nginx:1.27 and pods Ready
crashy: container command fixed to sleep (pods Ready, no more CrashLoopBackOff)
huge: impossible cpu request fixed to 100m and pods Ready
zero-dep: scaled to 3 with 3 replicas Ready
broken-svc: targetPort corrected to 80; tester reaches the Service
no-ep-svc: selector corrected to app=web; Service has endpoints
oom: memory limit raised to 128Mi; pod Running (was OOMKilled)
env-app: missing GREETING=hello env added; pod Running
stuck-sc: PVC rescued from a missing StorageClass and now Bound
sec-reader: reads /creds/password (secret key mapping fixed); pod Running
broken-ing: backend Service corrected; curl with Host header serves nginx
netpol-block: policy removed/relaxed; tester reaches web-svc again
